m: Wild *grass* and a bush whose branches block the path like a *door bar*; you hack through with a *standing knife*: the **chaste tree**.
A *sparrow* perches on the top of the *mountain*, so high you can barely see it: **lofty**.
A *standing person* under the *cliff* watches a huge *sparrow* flying south in a V: a **wild goose**.
His sash of *silk thread* is pinned with a golden *skewer*: a member of the **gentry**.
The sea *king* keeps a *bamboo book* whose pages are pink, branching stone: **coral**.
A *square* sheet is nailed to the village *tree*, and everyone crowds round the exam results: the **list of names**.
*Elbow* on an upturned *bucket*, the boy sends out *small speech bubble* after bubble: he **recites** the poem.
A *standing person* waits close beside the *square*: **near** it.
On a *podium* under the *cliff*, a man with neat *bristles* of beard gives a learned talk: **accomplished**.
Keep the *wine jug* away from the *child*: it holds strong **alcohol**.
Cut a length of *bamboo*, dig a little *pit* of holes along it and blow: a **flute**.
A *person* finds *paw prints* and feathers by the hen house: the **fowl** have escaped.
A *pennant* flaps over a *blanket* spread on the lawn: the sign says **do not** step here.
A *woman* sings, her *mouth* lifted to the *moon*: so **graceful**.
Lying in the *grass* with one *eye* shut, you look across the *rice field* and **take aim**.
A *towel* hung from a pole on the *podium* in the *village* square: the town's **banner**.
Bandits smash through your *roof* and carry off everything inside: they **plunder** the house.
An old man with *grey hair* shades his *eye* from the *sun* to **observe** the ships.
Under the *moon*, a *left hand* slips a *shell* beneath the table: **bribery**.
Your *kicking foot* comes down on a *claw*-shaped root of the *tree*: you **step on** it.
In the *rain*, a giant with a *long stride* bangs his *shoulder pole* across the sky: a **clap of thunder**.
A wet *crow* opens its *mouth* and gives a sad little **whimper**.
In front of the *curtains*, two *helping hands* clasp together over a *hurdle* and bow: they **cup hands** in salute.
A *woman* in silk, her hair wound in a *coiled rope* of jewels, lives in the palace: an **imperial consort**.
He waves at your hard work as if it were a blade of *grass*: he **belittles** it.
Under the *moon*, a *small speech bubble* comes out of the royal *tent*; a guard with a *standing knife* reads the emperor's **decree**.
Use *silk thread* and your *thumb* to **bind** the young plants of the *seedbed* to sticks.
A *bowing man* by the *cliff* hides a *bent knife* behind his *small speech bubble* of flattery: **sly**.
Boatmen with *trudging feet* haul along the river *road*; above the *wheat* in the hold a *bamboo* mat catches the wind: the boat's **sail**.
*Lightning bolts* split the sky and *water drops* pour down until even the *big man* is under: the town **floods**.
Under the *roof*, by the *moon* and the *dusk moon*, a *bowing man* twists his hand round and round: his **wrist**.
Grandma, *grey hair* tied up, sets the pot on *embers* as hot as the *sun*: she **boils** dumplings.
A *standing person* in a dress as green as fresh *moss*: so **pretty**.
A *pawn* on the chessboard, wearing a helmet like a *lid*: a foot **soldier**.
On long *legs*, a man with a *strong arm* opens an *open crate* of tools and a *candy* for luck: he will **survey** the land.
*Incense* smoke curls up past your *eyebrow*: how **fragrant**.
On the *road*, he rolls a *bean* to the puppy, then snatches it back: he **teases** it.
A *blanket* of *rice fields* wraps round the town: the **outskirts**.
*Twin blades* cut the *shell* price in half, then in half again: dirt **cheap**.
Over the *campfire*, add a *pinch* of salt and toss everything fast in the wok: **stir-fry**.
A *campfire* on the top of the *mountain* lights up the whole valley: a **glorious** blaze.
Knock down the walls with a *cane* until the room is a wide-open *mouth*: **spacious**.
Bees, busy little *bugs*, build combs over the *hurdle*; in the *sun* the combs soften into **wax**.
A *person* shut inside a *fence* with no gate: a **prisoner**.
A squirrel's *cabinet* in the *tree*, stuffed with spiky brown nuts for winter: **chestnuts**.
A *cross* is chalked on the *mouth* that spat a *chili* at the judge: guilty of a **crime**.
A *helping hand* rolls cloth into a soft *pill* and sets it on the hard *soil* to sit on: a **cushion**.
A *woman* peers round the *door* at her neighbour's new dress, green with **envy**.
The biggest *ghost* holds the *dipper* and serves himself first: the **chief**.
One *small speech bubble* passes from ear to ear and grows wilder each time: a **rumor**.
A *big man* sits alone under a *roof* overgrown with *grass*, watching the *sun* go down: **lonesome**.
Throw a *fishing net* over a *bug* curled up in a *blanket*: the silkworms of old **Sichuan**.
Swing a *bucket* round and round on a *ski* pole, then let it go: **fling** it.
From the *cliff*, past *soil* and more *soil*, out to where *water drops* meet the sky: the **horizon**.
Carve a *pillow* from a *tree* stump and lay your head on it: a hard wooden **pillow**.
*Downstairs* in the subway, a *begging bowl* waits at the *snake bend* of the crowd: a **beggar**.
Jump into the *stream* and kick the *water drops* up behind you: **swim**.
A *big man* stands astride two heaps of *soil*, legs wide apart: the gap between them is his **crotch**.
A *pinned heart* slowly oozes *water drops*: it **secretes**.
On the *road* past the last *tent*, under the *moon*, a guard with a *standing knife* stops you: you **exceed** the limit.
A mosquito's *mouth* is sharp as a *nail*: it **stings** you.
A *standing person* dips a *tethered arrow* in *soot* and draws dark lines over her eyes: **eyebrow paint**.
Three *mouths* gasp for water as a *campfire* blazes beside a *tree*: the air is so **dry**.
A *helping hand* hurls dice with *horns* high into the *sky* over the *hillside*: **throw**!
In the *sun*, a farmer hauls his *plough* over a *hurdle*, crushing the *grass* as he goes: he **treads on** it.
An *open crate* made from a *tree*, its lid swinging like the blades of *scissors*: the **hinge**.
Your *standing heart* burns as hot as the *sun* when he walks in: you **detest** him.
A *fish* so huge that other fish look like *crumbs* beside it: a **whale**.
Draw a giant *bow* back past your *elbow* and let fly: a **great** shot.
A tired *standing person* rests against a *big man* who stands firm as a *nail*, *mouth* open: she **leans on** him.
A *standing person* knocks the *slanted cap* off someone's *mother*: an **insult**.
*Grass* and *water drops* ring the *rice field*, and the *animal tracks* stop at its edge: a protective **hedge**.
A *helping hand* flicks a *bow*'s string across your sleeve to **brush off** the dust.
A *bird* like a giant white *sparrow*, standing on one leg with a *towel* round its neck: a **crane**.
A *bug* sits in the *side dish* and nibbles away at it: it **eats into** your dinner.
Stir flour into the *water* until it turns gloopy: a **thick liquid**.
A *person* crosses *two planks* above the pond *grass* to pick a pink **lotus**.
Dirty *soil* and litter piled up behind the *podium* after the show: **garbage**.
Grandpa with *grey hair* blows a *puff of breath* on the *campfire* to **roast** sweet potatoes.
The *sun* shines straight into the *bird nest*, and the chicks stretch out to **bask** in it.
Overnight the *rain* freezes on every *tree*, and your *eye* sees white everywhere: **frost**.
Bandits hide by the *wavy river*, in the *rice field* and up a *tree*; a soldier raises his *standing knife* to **wipe out** the gang.
Dry *grass* in the *sun*, tie it with *silk thread*, stack it in a *dish*: you **store up** plenty for winter.
A *chaser* runs over the *soil* after bags blowing in the wind: picking up **rubbish**.
*Silk thread* woven in a *rice field* pattern, smooth against your *mouth*: fine **silk**.
A tiny *mountain* out at sea, wrapped in waves like a *gift*: an **islet**.
The lightest *steam* of all, floating up and filling the balloons: **hydrogen**.
A *horse* with a *roof* on its back, scooping water with a *spoon*-shaped lip: a **camel**.
A *woman* sits on a *split log* before the mirror and paints her face: **makeup**.
A *helping hand* gathers *tree* branches inside a *fence* of rope and pulls it tight: a **bundle**.
*Gold coins* that are dull grey and far too heavy: fakes made of **lead**.
The *king* and his *prowling dog* wander slowly down the *road*, in no hurry: a **stroll**.
*Upstairs*, a *right hand* softly sweeps up *crumbs* and wipes away *water drops*: a **gentle** lady.
A *kneeling man* in the *rice field* and another *kneeling man* beside him pick red fruit full of jewel-like seeds from a *tree*: **pomegranates**.
A *person* under an *archway* with a *plank* on top: a three-legged *tripod*, standing **third** in line.
Lying on a *sickbed* stuffed with *sheep* wool, you scratch and scratch: you **itch**.
Too many *gold coins* to carry? Swap them for a *pinch* of printed paper: **paper money**.
A *kicking foot* wrapped in a hard *towel*, with no toes at all: a horse's **hoof**.
A *big man* with a *drop* by his ear: that drop is the floppy ear of his *dog*, his loyal **dog**.
Bend your *torso* into a curve like a *bow*: **bow** politely.
Lay a *ruler* from *sunrise* to sunset and measure the light: the **daytime**.
*Grass* sways among the *water drops* like an underwater *tree*, and three fish *mouths* nibble it: **aquatic grass**.
A *bug* with *red lacquer* markings spins a web in the corner: a **spider**.
The *cloaked beggar*'s *shirt* has faded in the *sun* to a dull **brown**.
A *person* sketches a face on a *page*: two *horns* of hair, a smile of *two planks*, and round pink **cheeks**.
A *big man* sets a *wine jug* with *horns* firmly into the ground as an offering: the new house is **settled**.
Under the *sun*, a *big man* with a *strong arm* waves his hat over the *grass* at the fair: he will **raise funds** for the school.
One *ear* sinks back into the *pillow* and you snooze again: you **delay** getting up.
A *kicking foot* and a *claw* stamp up and down on grain in the *mortar*: they **tread** it.
A rough hut of sticks on the bare *hillside*: small, plain and **humble**.
A *standing person* and two *mouths* chatting together: he always walks with a **companion**.
A *ghost* hides inside a *sapling*, luring travellers with its magic: a **demon**.
The *wind* blows soft grey cloud round and round the *mountain*: **mountain mist**.
A young *standing person* runs to the *arrow landing* where your brother shot: his son, your **nephew**.
A *tiger* rules the forest by terror, roaring at anyone smaller: **brutal**.
Your *left hand* slips on the *hillside*, and under the *moon* you tumble onto the *soil*: you **fall**.
*Twins* stand guard on *soil* steps cut into the *hillside* up to the emperor: the **throne steps**.
Morning dew sparkles on the *grass* like tiny jewels: **lustrous** as jade.
On the *hillside*, the *grass* under the old tree stays cool and pale as the *moon*: the **shade**.
A *prowling dog* lifts the *lid* behind the *curtains* and snips the string with *scissors* to steal the meat: **cunning**.
At the *gate*, a *standing person* with a *halberd* lets in only family friends: a powerful **clique**.
Wind *silk thread* round the *lid*, through the *curtains* and between the *scissors* blades, then turn: **twist** it tight.
A tall jar on the chemist's top shelf, full of something thick you rub into sore skin: **ointment**.
The *big man* heaps *soil* on top of a *leaky pot*; it cracks, and the whole pile **collapses**.
Follow the *grass* down from the flower to the long green stalk: the **stem**.
A *silk thread* ties you to a *face* far, far away: thinking of someone **remote**.
Two *mouths* up a *tree* blow a horn shaped like a *standing knife*: 'la-ba' goes the trumpet, a **phonetic la**.
A *left hand* strokes *silk thread* so soft that even a *halberd* slides off it: **velvet**.
A *helping hand* keeps poking the *watcher* while he tries to read: you **disturb** him.
Sit down with *spread feet* on a little seat that has no back: a **stool**.
A smooth piece of *tree* wood flies from *elbow* to *elbow* across the loom: the **shuttle**.
A *pole* with two *horns* sticking up from its top: a **fork** in the branch.
A noble *woman* rides through town in a gilded *open crate*: a palace **lady**.
A *small speech bubble* from the emperor's *mouth*, sealed and its cord cut with a *knife*: an **imperial edict**.
Cut *gold coins* with a *knife*, drill holes between *two planks* of thread, sew it on: a **button**.
A *tree* cut into one long box with a *roof* for a lid, like *stacked drawers*: a **coffin**.
His *ear* glows red by the *campfire* as he tells the whole truth: **honest** and upright.
Knot *silk thread* through two *towels* to join them for good: **form a union**.
His *standing heart* hangs idle on an *ox horn* like an old coat: **lax**.
A *woman* lies on a *sickbed*, pierced by the *arrow* of her sister's success: **jealous**.
Build a *campfire* inside a ring of baked *soil* to cook on: a kitchen **stove**.
Spread the *blanket* flat under the *lid* so every part lies the same: **even**.
When the old *boss* retires, his son takes his chair: he **inherits** the business.
A *bird* by the *tent* coos softly through its little *mouth*: a **pigeon**.
Three *mouths* splash *water drops* over a tub made from a *tree*: **bath** time.
Up on the *scaffold*, a stonemason taps a sharp tool into the rock: a **chisel**.
*Silk thread* runs round the globe like a *leather strap*: a line of **latitude**.
*Water drops* leap like arrows off a *bow* in the pot: it **boils**.
Your *thumb* traces the *rice field* and the rows of *wheat* on the map: the **arable fields**.
A *drop* of light glints along the *knife*: its razor-sharp **blade edge**.
